#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long fastPow(long long x, long long y) {
    if (x == 1) return 1;
    if (y == 0) return 1;
    long long p = fastPow(x, y / 2) % MOD;
    p = p * p % MOD;
    if (y % 2 == 1) p = p * x % MOD;
    return p;
}

long long obrat2() {
    return fastPow(2, MOD - 2);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    long long total = r - l + 1;

    if (n % 2 != 0 && m % 2 != 0) {
        cout << fastPow(total, n * m) << "\n";
    } else {
        long long res1 = fastPow(total, n * m - 1);
        long long res;
        if (total % 2 == 0) {
            res = res1 * (total / 2) % MOD;
        } else {
            res = (res1 * ((total + 1) / 2) % MOD + MOD - ((res1 + MOD - 1) % MOD) * obrat2() % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        cout << res << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
